• 本校僅開放交換生修讀學士班課程。
• 英語授課領域一覽
-Administration and Business Management in English
-Marketing in English
-Tourism in English
-International Relations in English
-Pre-primary Education in English
-Primary Education in English
-Protocol, Organization of Events and Corporate Communications in English
-Economics in English
-Biomedical Engineering in English (FUENLABRADA CAMPUS)
-Biomedical Engineering in English (ALCORCÓN CAMPUS)

*申請Health Sciences (except Pharmacy and Psychology) 須達DELE B2

*提供學期間付費西語語言課程｜依《國立臺灣師範大學學生境外修習課程實施辦法》，交換生每學期至少應修習 2 科或 6 學分，歐洲 ECTS 原則以 2 ECTS 等同 1 學分，採認學分上限為畢業最低總學分數三分之一（於大陸地區修習之課程不得採計為師資職前教育專業及專門課程）。

• Japanese studies department
o Courses from the 1st year of bachelor degree are closed
o Students wishing to take courses from the 2nd year of Bachelor degree must have a JLPT N3 with a minimum grade of 120/180
o Students wishing to take courses from the 3rd year of Bachelor degree must have a JLPT N2
• Russian, Arabic and Chinese studies departments – Full beginner classes are closed to exchange students. Students wishing to take courses from these departments must attest that they previously studied the language for about 200 hours.；【Thematic and Disciplinary courses】Thematic and Disciplinary courses – French B1/B2 level achieved
Exchange students with at least an intermediate level in French (B2 recommended) can enrol in courses which focus on examining phenomena through a cross-national lens.
• Anthropology
• World art
• Global political issues
• Environment
• Gender and sexuality in the world
• Connected world history
• Linguistics
• Literature, arts and translation
• Orality
• Philosophies from elsewhere
• Religion Violence, migration, memory；【Professional Track courses】此學程需要提供法檢+英檢證明
Professional Track courses – French C1 level achieved (+B2 in English)
• International Trade
• International Relations
• Intercultural Communication
• Language Didactics
• Texts, Informatics and Multilingualism；【French Language courses (Inal’FLE)】*選擇此學程需注意語言課程之成績單恐無法通過教育部獎學金結案。
French Language courses (Inal’FLE) – no minimum, full beginners accepted
Inalco offers French as a Foreign Language courses. All proficiency levels are available from A1 (full beginner) to C1 (advanced).
Please note that a French language test will be sent to all incoming students before their arrival at Inalco, regardless of the courses they decide to take. Its results will determine the group level to which the student will be registered at Inalco, regardless of other results from DELF/DALF exams.｜依《國立臺灣師範大學學生境外修習課程實施辦法》，交換生每學期至少應修習 2 科或 6 學分，歐洲 ECTS 原則以 2 ECTS 等同 1 學分，採認學分上限為畢業最低總學分數三分之一（於大陸地區修習之課程不得採計為師資職前教育專業及專門課程）。

**該校接受交換生跨領域修課，不過部分領域有條件限制：
‧Biomedical Sciences(生物醫學科學)：本領域需要先備知識，需要檢附本領域相關課程的修課紀錄。
‧Business School(商學院)：初次接觸本領域之同學建議從第一年(Stage 1)的課程開始修起，交換生限修20學分。
‧English Literature, Creative Writing, and Linguistics(英國文學、創意寫作及語言學)：
-英國文學：尚未修過英國文學相關課程的同學，請從Stage 1的課程開始選讀。

-語言學：本領域需要有語言學相關的修課經驗，若無經驗的話可以選擇SEL3349 The History of Linguistic Ideas課程，這門課需要的先備知識較少。
‧Law(法學)、Mathematics, Statistics and Physics(數學、統計及物理)及Psychology(心理學)領域「不開放」交換生選修。

【目前僅開放以下三個院系申請】
‧School of Education, Languages and Linguistics
‧School of Criminology and Criminal Justice
‧School of Area Studies, Sociology, History, Politics and Literature
【以下院系已全面停止開放申請】
‧Faculty of Creative and Cultural Industries
‧Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
請有意申請樸資茅斯大學的同學，務必重新檢視您的修課計畫是否與目前開放的院系相符。
-英國地區學校交換生每學期至少需修讀60學分(30ECTS=15師大學分，約五堂課)，國際處無法協調降低修課學分數，請自行評估是否選擇該地區學校交換。｜依《國立臺灣師範大學學生境外修習課程實施辦法》，交換生每學期至少應修習 2 科或 6 學分，歐洲 ECTS 原則以 2 ECTS 等同 1 學分，採認學分上限為畢業最低總學分數三分之一（於大陸地區修習之課程不得採計為師資職前教育專業及專門課程）。
